errors.text_span: всеки от които съответства на различен времеви интервал
errors.evidence: The description claims that each sector corresponds to a different time interval. However, one of the categories, "Не сме организирали обучения по лидерство" (We have not organized leadership training), is not a time interval.

The description identifies the orange sector as "the largest sector". This is incorrect, as both the orange sector ("От 6 до 15 години") and the red sector ("От 1 до 5 години") are of the same size, each representing 36.4%. It should have been described as one of the two largest sectors.

errors.text_span: като всички сектори са етикетирани с проценти вътре в тях, с изключение на трите по-малки
errors.evidence: The phrasing "all sectors are labeled... with the exception of the three smaller ones" is convoluted and awkward. A clearer way to state this would be "The three largest sectors are labeled with percentages, while the three smaller ones are not."
